title: CakeFest 2022: The Official CakePHP Conference
content:
- our annual conference dedicated to CakePHP will be virtual this year allowing bakers from all over the world to attend, from home! Two full days of CakePHP knowledge. Day 1 is workshops and day 2 will be a full day of talks on CakePHP related technologies. These events are an ideal way to learn as both beginners and advanced users. CakeFest 2022

Date: September 29 & 30 Time: 12:00pm UTC

Check out details at: CakeFest.org
author: PHP.net news & announcements
